WITH captured(current_time_utc) AS ( VALUES (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')) ), details(current_time_utc, current_time_epoch, local_offset_seconds) AS ( SELECT current_time_utc, strftime('%s', current_time_utc), unixepoch(datetime(current_time_utc, 'localtime')) - unixepoch(datetime(current_time_utc)) FROM captured ), formats(name, utc, localtime) AS ( SELECT 'iso8601', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', current_time_utc) || 'Z', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', current_time_utc, 'localtime') || printf('%+03d:%02d', local_offset_seconds / 3600, abs(local_offset_seconds) / 60 % 60) FROM details
UNION ALL SELECT 'rfc3339', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', current_time_utc), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', current_time_utc, 'localtime') || printf('%+03d:%02d', local_offset_seconds / 3600, abs(local_offset_seconds) / 60 % 60) FROM details
UNION ALL SELECT 'datetime', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', current_time_utc), strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', current_time_utc, 'localtime') FROM details
UNION ALL SELECT 'date', date(current_time_utc), date(current_time_utc, 'localtime') FROM details
UNION ALL SELECT 'time', strftime('%H:%M:%S', current_time_utc), strftime('%H:%M:%S', current_time_utc, 'localtime') FROM details
UNION ALL SELECT 'time-12', CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', current_time_utc) AS INTEGER) = 0 THEN '12:' || strftime('%M:%S AM', current_time_utc) WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', current_time_utc) AS INTEGER) < 12 THEN strftime('%H:%M:%S AM', current_time_utc) ELSE printf('%02d:%s PM', CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', current_time_utc) AS INTEGER) = 12 THEN 12 ELSE CAST(strftime('%H', current_time_utc) AS INTEGER) - 12 END, strftime('%M:%S', current_time_utc) ) END, CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', current_time_utc, 'localtime') AS INTEGER) = 0 THEN '12:' || strftime('%M:%S AM', current_time_utc, 'localtime') WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', current_time_utc, 'localtime') AS INTEGER) < 12 THEN strftime('%H:%M:%S AM', current_time_utc, 'localtime') ELSE printf('%02d:%s PM', CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', current_time_utc, 'localtime') AS INTEGER) = 12 THEN 12 ELSE CAST(strftime('%H', current_time_utc, 'localtime') AS INTEGER) - 12 END, strftime('%M:%S', current_time_utc, 'localtime') ) END FROM details
UNION ALL SELECT 'epoch', current_time_epoch, current_time_epoch FROM details
UNION ALL SELECT 'excelSerial', CAST(julianday(current_time_utc) - 2415018.5 AS TEXT), CAST(julianday(current_time_utc, 'localtime') - 2415018.5 AS TEXT) FROM details
UNION ALL SELECT 'dayofyear', strftime('%j', current_time_utc), strftime('%j', current_time_utc, 'localtime') FROM details ) SELECT name, utc, localtime FROM formats ORDER BY 1;

SELECT ordinal + 1, substr(remaining, 1, instr(remaining, char(10)) - 1), substr(remaining, instr(remaining, char(10)) + 1) FROM required_split WHERE instr(remaining, char(10)) > 0 ), required_raw(name, ordinal) AS ( SELECT trim(value, ' ' || char(9) || char(13)), ordinal FROM required_split WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND trim(value, ' ' || char(9) || char(13)) <> '' ), required(name, ordinal) AS ( SELECT name, min(ordinal) FROM required_raw GROUP BY name ), attribute_split(entity_id, value, remaining) AS ( SELECT rowid, NULL, coalesce(attributes, '') || ',' FROM entities
UNION ALL
SELECT entity_id, substr(remaining, 1, instr(remaining, ',') - 1), substr(remaining, instr(remaining, ',') + 1) FROM attribute_split WHERE instr(remaining, ',') > 0 ), provided(entity_id, name) AS ( SELECT entity_id, trim( substr(value, 1, instr(value, '=') - 1), ' ' || char(9) || char(13) ) FROM attribute_split WHERE instr(value, '=') > 0 ), missing(entity_id, name, ordinal) AS ( SELECT e.rowid, r.name, r.ordinal FROM entities AS e CROSS JOIN required AS r WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provided AS p WHERE p.entity_id = e.rowid AND p.name = r.name ) ) SELECT e.name, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM missing AS m WHERE m.entity_id = e.rowid ) THEN 'Missing' ELSE 'OK' END AS status, coalesce(( SELECT group_concat(name, ', ') FROM ( SELECT name FROM missing AS m WHERE m.entity_id = e.rowid ORDER BY ordinal ) ), '') AS missing FROM entities AS e ORDER BY e.name;
